selection: Both have 100 customers, the largest current dataset size. L06 extends an earlier case (5 satellites, 3 batches); L07 has 3 satellites and 4 batches with two 35-unit demand peaks.
decision: Preserve every run and failure; no retries, seed selection, parameter tuning or additional cases based on outcomes. Compare independent physical and double-cycle audits, full costs, pool size, CPU time and repair overhead. A single seed does not establish expected performance.
